name: Marta Iachetta
body: Our first encounter with Paul was when our son, Jackson, was about 12 years old--let's say 10 or so years ago. Jackson was playing a gig with his friends/bandmates in the You Rock School of Music Select Band at a RI Oyster Fest in downtown Providence. Paul was the point person for the musicians and he couldn't have been kinder and more generous with his praise. He exuded cool and kindness all at once. He loved the band and let them know it, thrilling them all and encouraging a new generation of musicians. We couldn't believe our good luck in how often we saw him after that, riding his bike around the neighborhood and giving us an extra warm smile of recognition. He was a special soul we knew only on the periphery and are not at all surprised by how deeply loved he was by all he knew at every level of  his orbit. With warmth and love, Marta Iachetta and Bob and Jackson L'Heureux
